about: The AI places your product in your own shop, like a real photo: one photo per colour, then the poster.

pay.gemini: Paid with your Google key (no credits)
pay.openai: Paid with your OpenAI key (no credits)

previewNote: Preview: no AI here. The photos are EXAMPLES drawn by the page, so you can try the steps.
off: Studio photo AI is switched off by Pilotix for now.
notImage: This file is not a photo.
needTwo: Add at least 2 photos of this product (2 to 5, from several angles).
saveFail: The photo could not be saved.

bg.title: Your backgrounds
bg.help: A photo of your shop, empty (no product on the table). Pilotix blurs it once and keeps it: all your photos get the same background. Draw the box of your logo: the product will never hide it.
bg.none: First add a photo of your shop, empty.
bg.pick: Pick a photo of the shop (empty)
bg.name: Name
bg.blurHint: Blurred enough for the product to stand out, the shop stays recognisable.
bg.focusHint: The white line: everything below it (the table) stays sharp.
bg.logoHint: Drag on the photo around your logo / sign. The product will never cover it.
bg.photoFixed: To change the photo or the blur, add a new background.

ph.title: The photos, colour by colour
ph.help: For each colour / size: 2 to 5 photos of this product alone (several angles). The AI makes 3 versions, checks them, and redoes once the one with a problem. Pick the best: it goes straight onto that colour.
ph.making: The AI is working… (30 s to 1 min)

key.title: Who pays for the AI?
key.creditsHelp: Each photo takes credits (paid in DA). Nothing else to do.
key.geminiHelp: You pay Google directly (card in dollars). No credits.
key.openaiHelp: You pay OpenAI directly (card in dollars). No credits.
key.kept: A key is already saved: leave empty to keep it.
key.keyHint: It is kept hidden and never shown.
key.openaiNoCheck: With an OpenAI key, the automatic check does not run: look at each photo yourself.

po.title: The poster (main photo)
po.help: Once every colour has its photo. The AI only suggests the words; the price, old price, phone and colours are written by Pilotix, so they cannot be wrong.
po.wait: First pick the photo of each colour ({{done}} / {{of}}).
po.example: Example words (no AI here): edit them.
po.saved: Poster saved as the main photo.
po.subtitle: Line under the title
po.rule: Check the price and the phone number before publishing.
